eyebrow: A Deployment and a Job both fall short

steps.label: Deployment
steps.sub: identical replicas — no rank, no master

steps.label: PyTorchJob
steps.sub: Master + Worker, wired by the operator

code:
apiVersion: kubeflow.org/v1
kind: PyTorchJob
metadata:
  name: solara-70b-train
  namespace: training
spec:
  pytorchReplicaSpecs:
    Master:
      replicas: 1
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
    Worker:
      replicas: 63
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
caption: Each replica requests nvidia.com/gpu: 8 — 64 replicas × 8 GPUs = the entire solara-train cluster.
